title: A first for Moldovan table tennis: Corporate Day 2023
body_html:
The summer corporate event for the bravest lads in the world of table tennis was a success!

On 30 June, ATTP, through SETKA-PRO Moldova and in cooperation with TOP-CUP Academy, held an exceptional corporate event for all its members. There was everything: contests, performers, the cover band “Stajilov&Co” and, of course, fiery dancing and lots of wonderful moments!

It was an unforgettable event! The way we had fun proved beyond doubt that we can not only work hard and play table tennis but also relax.

The last year and a half has been incredibly productive and remarkable. May next year bring success in everything we have planned and be a year full of happy events for all of us!

Here we have picked just some of the moments captured that day — and you, dear friends, tell us in the comments what you remember most from the event.

Thank you to everyone who was with us that day!
